newsitem.title: UK: National Express awards contract to Adtranz.
newsitem.headline: National Express awards contract to Adtranz.

text.p: British rail to bus giant National Express Group plc said on Thursday it awarded a 38 million pound order for new rolling stock to Germany's Adtranz which will double its service on its Midland Mainline franchise.
The order for the 13 diesel units will allow the company to extend its franchise from 10 years from seven, National Express said in a statement.
The trains will come into service in the summer of 1999 and will operate alongside Midland Mainline's existing fleet of 14 High Speed Trains which are currently undergoing total refurbishment.
The building and maintenance contract for the 13 Diesel Units awarded to Adtranz will secure approximately 200 jobs in the Derby area, National Express said.
The company said rail infrastructure company Railtrack will be investing over seven million pounds to provide the extra track capacity required.
On Wednesday, Britain's railway regulator said it would seek an amendment to Railtrack's license to ensure the company would carry out its 1.0 billion pounds station improvement plan.
